sources.quote: Some of the game's art assets, such as character and enemy models, portraits and icons, were created during development with the assistance of generative AI tools, and were then reviewed, curated and edited by the team. The music in our trailer and some of the game's sound effects and voices were also generated with AI tools, then edited and mixed by the team. All AI-assisted content is pre-rendered: nothing is generated while the game is running.
